question: What is claimed of even the wise one when acting at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence?
premises: Action is taken at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence.
In that state, one is burning.
This holds even for the wise one.
inference: Even the wise one, while burning, acts at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of essence, even the wise one, while burning, does so.
